reproduction.description: Jointly infer row and column membership and reorder a noisy planted binary block.
differences: Seeded synthetic data, not measurements from the named original benchmark.
One 48×24 binary block replaces the binary, three-level and overlapping multi-block suites.
Deterministic mean-field updates with disclosed fixed p(background)=0.04, p(block)=0.92 and membership prior 0.3 replace biclusteringGibbs. No MCMC posterior claim.
